description: This file defines a Flutter widget called FavoritesTab, which displays either a placeholder message when there are no favorite recipes or a list of favorite items using ListView.

classes.name: FavoritesTab
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays either a placeholder for favorite recipes or a list of favorites.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the FavoritesTab, showing either a message when the favorites list is empty or a list of favorite items.
